title: Service Satisfaction (English)
intro: Hello. We are conducting a brief survey. Please respond using your keypad or voice.
outro: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with our service? Press 1 for Very Satisfied, 2 for Satisfied, 3 for Dissatisfied, or 4 for Very Dissatisfied.
We're sorry to hear that. In your own words, please tell us why you were not satisfied.
Would you recommend us? Press 1 for Yes, or 2 for No.
